positions.title: Web Developer / Data Analyst
positions.description: At Apex Systems, I worked in one of today's largest tech companies. I had the incredible opportunity of exploring a large organization, where I helped brainstorm, design, and implement web applications to help improve or replace existing tools for teams and individuals.

positions.description: Infinite Options is a start-up aimed at quickly developing applications to explore possible markets and growing interns through job training and preparation. Currently, I work on both front-end and back-end tasks for a web application with a preexisting code base.

positions.title: Web Application Developer

From this project, I further strengthened good coding practices using React and integrating React applications with existing Firebase projects.

projects.title: Earthquake Early Warning
projects.description: Graduation requirement for San Jose State University's B.S. in Software Engineering. Earthquake Early Warning is a system that allows users to subscribe to SMS alerts using a web application. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts by using transfer learning to adapt a deep neural network for use in classifying seismic, time-series data. Demonstrated deep understanding of full-stack development by utilizing Amazon Web Services, Digital Ocean, and Angular to display real-time seismic data and seismic signal classification on an Angular web application.

projects.title: Gratis Web Application
projects.description: Core team member of the development team. Documented, implemented, tested, and delivered code in an Agile setting. Strengthened good coding practices using React. Strengthened full-stack development by integrating React applications with existing Firebase projects.
